text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san, that was so close. My hands were 
totally sweating.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I was just really happy that 
you tried to get it for me, Tore-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
